target ktpu.v9
fn loop.l1(cnt: u64[4] @dram, x: f16[16, 256] @dram, y: f16[16, 256] @dram)
    r1 = load cnt
    r2 = set 0
    label top
    r3 = mul r2, 512
    move
        copy w(x + r3, (16, 32)) -> w(y + r3, (16, 32))
    r2 = add r2, 1
    goto top if r2 < r1
    store cnt + 8 <- r2
